title: predication-priestley-dual
description: The dual representation of a predication fiber algebra: applying Spec coordinatewise to the twist product yields a paired Priestley space, the object-level component of the Jung-Rivieccio duality, so that growth in the knowledge order is dual to shrinking possibility space.

dualOf.description: the predication fiber algebra A_p whose Priestley dual this is

pairedPriestleySpace.description: the dual is a paired Priestley space, the codomain of the object-level Jung-Rivieccio duality on A_p

specCoordinatewise.description: obtained by applying Spec to each coordinate of the twist product of A_p

knowledgeFilterDuality.description: accumulation of evidence in the knowledge order <=_k is dual to filter-tightening: knowledge grows is dual to possibility space shrinks
